title: Soul Revolution 1
text: that's all revolution explodes in the very depths of your being when you wake up from the dream of a separate existence when you see suddenly dawns on me that who you really are is God the Creator the energy and intelligence that gave rise to this universe the evolutionary impulse the creative force behind the whole universe and when you realize that unequivocally at the level of pure experience as a direct revelation something explodes in your nervous system your mind shifts your inspiration ships you realize you here for a completely different reason than when you thought you were you're here for different reasons and when your parents told you your teachers told you you're here to create the universe through the vehicle that God gave you and when you know that you feel free you feel free from all the burdens and all the problems of a personal life and a personal existence from a life that's not live in enlightened brims that's the beginning of a completely new chapter
